projects.title: Compliance Automation Platform
projects.summary: Automated SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR & PCI compliance evidence collection across 40+ SaaS platforms for a YC-backed startup.
projects.description:
At Nyntax, I engineered a compliance automation platform that dramatically reduces the manual effort required for security audits. The system integrates with 40+ third-party platforms via their APIs and browser-based automation (Puppeteer / CUA) to gather audit-ready evidence automatically.

The platform was purpose-built to support Delve, a Y Combinator-backed compliance startup, enabling their customers to achieve and maintain certifications in SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI without tedious manual evidence gathering.

Core engineering challenges included handling rate-limited APIs reliably, building resilient browser automation that survives UI changes, and designing a workflow engine that parallelises evidence collection across dozens of platforms while keeping results consistent and idempotent.

The result: control testing that previously took days of analyst time now runs in hours, with a structured evidence corpus ready for auditors.
highlights: Integrated 40+ compliance platforms (AWS, GitHub, Google Workspace, Jira, etc.) for automated evidence collection
Built resilient Puppeteer/CUA automation for platforms without public APIs
Designed idempotent workflow engine for parallel control testing
Delivered SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI audit-ready evidence for Delve (YC-backed)
Reduced manual evidence collection from days to hours

projects.title: Job Portal Admin Panel
projects.summary: Built 80% of the admin dashboard for a large-scale job site, integrating AWS AppSync, DynamoDB, and Cognito.
projects.description:
During my time at Doodle Inc., I led the frontend development of a feature-rich admin panel for a high-traffic job site. The panel gave administrators full visibility and control over job listings, applicants, employer accounts, and site analytics.

I contributed approximately 80% of the total admin panel codebase using React, Redux Toolkit, and Tailwind CSS. The state management architecture was carefully designed to handle complex async flows with RTK Query, minimising redundant API calls.

On the backend side, I optimised AppSync GraphQL queries to reduce data transfer and improved cold-start performance. I also integrated AWS Cognito for role-based access control, distinguishing super-admins from site managers with fine-grained permissions.
highlights: Developed ~80% of the admin panel UI from scratch
Optimised AppSync GraphQL queries for reduced latency
Integrated AWS Cognito for role-based access control
Built reusable component library with Tailwind and RTK Query

projects.title: Enquire Space
projects.summary: A Quora-inspired Q&A platform with multimedia support and a contributor rewards system.
projects.description:
Enquire Space is a community knowledge-sharing platform I built in 2023. Inspired by Quora, it allows users to post questions, contribute answers in multiple content formats (text, images, embedded video), and earn reward points for high-quality contributions.

The rewards system was designed to incentivise knowledge sharing — users accumulate points that unlock profile badges and featured placement. The platform includes a full authentication flow, real-time notification system, and a rich text editor for formatting answers.

Built as a full-stack project using Next.js (SSR for SEO), Node.js/Express backend, and MongoDB. The frontend uses a clean card-based layout with infinite scroll.
highlights: Full-stack Q&A platform with multimedia answer support
Points-based rewards system for contributor incentivisation
Real-time notifications and activity feed
SSR with Next.js for improved SEO

projects.title: Multiclass Fake News Detection with BiLSTM
projects.summary: Conference-published NLP research using Bidirectional LSTM to classify fake news across multiple categories.
projects.description:
In 2021, I co-authored a research paper published at the CLEF 2021 CheckThat! Lab, targeting multiclass fake news detection using deep learning.

The system employs a Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM) architecture trained on a labelled dataset of news articles to classify them into multiple veracity categories. Text preprocessing, tokenisation, and embedding strategies were central to improving classification accuracy.

The paper was published in the CEUR Workshop Proceedings (Vol. 2936) and represents one of the earliest applications of BiLSTM to multiclass fake news classification in low-resource settings.
highlights: Published at CLEF 2021 CheckThat! Lab (CEUR-WS Vol. 2936)
Multiclass fake news classification with BiLSTM
Custom text preprocessing and embedding pipeline
Benchmarked against baseline NLP classifiers

projects.title: Quiz Web App
projects.summary: Interactive quiz application with multiple categories and score tracking.
projects.description:
A browser-based quiz application that presents multiple-choice questions across various knowledge categories. Users can select a category, answer timed questions, and receive a score summary at the end.

Built with React on the frontend with a clean, responsive UI. State management handles question progression, timer logic, and score accumulation. Results are displayed with a breakdown by category.
highlights: Multi-category quiz with timed questions
Responsive UI with score breakdown
Smooth animations between question transitions

projects.title: Grocery Management System
projects.summary: Desktop application for managing grocery inventory, purchases, and sales records.
projects.description:
A grocery management desktop application built for small retail stores. It handles product catalogue management, stock tracking, purchase order recording, and basic sales reporting.

The system provides a simple tabular interface for adding, editing, and removing grocery items, with automatic stock level alerts when quantities fall below thresholds.
highlights: Inventory tracking with low-stock alerts
Purchase and sales record management
PDF report generation

projects.title: Student Registration Logger
projects.summary: Automated logging system for student registration events and academic records.
projects.description:
A student registration logging system designed for academic institutions. It records enrolment events, tracks course registrations, and generates summaries for administrative use.

The system captures registration timestamps, course selections, and student metadata, allowing administrators to generate formatted reports and detect anomalies in the registration process.
highlights: Automated registration event logging
Admin dashboard with filterable student records
Exportable registration reports

projects.title: Parental Control System
projects.summary: Desktop application enabling parents to monitor and restrict child device usage.
projects.description:
A desktop parental control application that allows parents to set usage time limits, block specific applications, and review activity logs for their children's devices.

The system runs as a background service that enforces configured restrictions and logs application usage with timestamps. A parent-facing dashboard provides a summary of daily usage patterns and allows on-the-fly policy changes.
highlights: Application blocking and time-limit enforcement
Activity logging with usage summaries
Parent dashboard for policy management
